proposals.before: This year’s Changyang drive began with orders to Right Fufeng: Taishan to the left, Baoxie to the right, passes blocked and cordons set, the southern range bent into a vast corral, a thousand chariots massed in the brush, ten thousand horsemen along the ridges, the host marshaled so that soldiers could win glory by seizing Hu prisoners.
proposals.after: This year’s Changyang drive began with orders to Right Fufeng: Mount Taihua to the left, Baoxie to the right, passes blocked and cordons set, the southern range bent into a vast corral, a thousand chariots massed in the brush, ten thousand horsemen along the ridges, the host marshaled so that soldiers could win glory by seizing Hu prisoners.
proposals.reason: Chinese 太華 is Mount Taihua (Hua), not Taishan; the idiomatic line mistranslates the mountain name.

decisions.reason: Focus Chinese 左太華而右褒斜 names Mount Taihua (太華), not Taishan (泰山). Idiomatic “Taishan” is a real naming error; “Mount Taihua” restores the correct mountain while leaving the rest of the accurate human phrasing intact.
